name: application-popover
title: Popover
description: Anchored overlay panels for contextual help, user info, and inline actions that appear next to a trigger element in web applications.
useWhen: Anchored overlay panels for contextual help, user info, and inline actions that appear next to a trigger element in web applications.
avoidWhen: Avoid popover when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Popover uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
